title: Lost, damaged, undelivered and defective packages: Urology and Continence Supply Program replacement terms
content:
A replacement package on the Urology and Continence Supply Program ships at no charge. It draws no authorized units and is never billed to a payer. It is recorded against the original shipment it replaces. Its quantity never exceeds the units of that original shipment that were lost, damaged, not received or defective.

## Proof of delivery

A proof of delivery is recorded as received from the carrier. It carries a signature where the tier or item requires a signature on delivery. The proof of delivery fixes the delivery date from which the return, damage and warranty windows count. A package without a proof of delivery has no delivery date.

## Replacement by cause

| Cause | When it is replaced | Terms |
|---|---|---|
| Lost in transit | No proof of delivery is on file for the package, and the tier's carrier trace period in business days has passed after the carrier's expected delivery date. Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays. | Always replaced, expedited at no charge. It does not count toward any courtesy limit, because Larkfield bears the risk until delivery. |
| Damaged in transit | The customer reports the damage no later than the tier's damage report window, in calendar days after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that package. The count runs in calendar days from that delivery date, and the last day is allowed. | A later damage report is not replaced. |
| Delivered but not received | The proof of delivery shows the package as delivered, but the customer reports it not received. | Replaced as a courtesy only while the program's courtesy reships in the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date are fewer than the tier's courtesy reship allowance. Beyond that, the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill. |
| Defective as shipped | A catheter or absorbent product arrived with the wrong French size, tip or product size, a broken sterile package, or from a recalled lot, and it is reported no later than the tier's defect report window, in calendar days after the delivery date. | Replaced as a product defect. A product that does not suit the customer is not a defect: it is a product change on a new written order. |

## Counting courtesy reships

The courtesy count is the number of the program's replacement shipments made for a package delivered but not received whose ship date falls in the 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the reship date being considered. Lost-in-transit, damage and defect replacements are not part of this count.

**Hypothetical case (one courtesy reship per rolling 12 months):** a program had a delivered-but-not-received replacement 200 days before a new report. The count is 1, which is not fewer than 1, so no courtesy reship is made. If that earlier replacement had been 400 days before, the count would be 0 and the courtesy reship would be made.

## Damage window boundary

**Hypothetical, 7-day window, delivery on day 0:**

| Report day | Replaced? |
|---|---|
| day 7 | yes: this is the last day allowed |
| day 8 | no |
